findings.message: invoices/send.spec.ts:28 'shows a success toast' failed 1 of 3 runs on an unchanged tree and passed on retry 1 (1 retry consumed). The assertion waits on getByRole('status') with a 5s timeout while the toast auto-dismisses, so it races the dismiss timer. Quarantine candidate until the wait is anchored to the toast's appearance rather than its presence.
findings.suggestion: Assert on the toast appearing (expect(toast).toBeVisible() immediately after the send click) rather than waiting for it to already be present, or freeze the dismiss timer in the test environment.
